name: Seesaw Vision Center
website: https://www.seesawvisioncenter.com/hours-location/east-brunswick/ (a second, older site also live: https://seesawvisioneb.com/)
what_they_do: Optometry practice doing comprehensive and pediatric eye exams, myopia management/ortho-K, vision therapy, dry eye and eye-disease management, plus an optical department selling glasses and contact lenses. East Brunswick is one of three Seesaw Vision locations (Warren, Livingston, East Brunswick) on a shared multi-location site.
customers: Local households and families with children (myopia control, pediatric exams), adults and seniors needing routine exams and eyewear; retail optical customers.

size_signals.signal: Three locations listed on site (Warren, Livingston, East Brunswick)
Four optometrists named in site nav: Dr. Sylvia Qiong Chen, Dr. Annie Liang, Dr. Clare Tao, Dr. Jingyi Alice Tang
Full 6-day schedule incl. Thursday to 7pm and Saturday to 3pm at the East Brunswick office

website_review.primary_cta: Book Appointment (real online scheduler on the booking page) plus sticky click-to-call and calendar icons on mobile
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Yes - a real-time scheduler with appointment-type and doctor pickers and open slots (verified on /book-appointment-east-brunswick/, no login wall)
website_review.trust_signals: Named doctors with individual bios, photos of the lobby and optical shop, patient testimonials on the site, insurance page; no star-rated review widget on the page itself
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Duplicate legacy GoDaddy site seesawvisioneb.com is still live with a 2025 copyright, the old phone (732) 247-2847 and phone-only booking; the East Brunswick page's LocalBusiness JSON-LD still carries the Livingston phone (908) 838-0660 and a Livingston 07039 description
website_review.search_basics: Strong: title and meta description name optometrist + East Brunswick, H1 matches, and each service (myopia management, ortho-K, pediatric, dry eye, optical) has its own page. robots.txt is wide open (User-Agent: * Allow: /) and names a sitemap.
top_issues: Two live websites for one practice with two different phone numbers - splits rankings and gives AI agents conflicting facts
LocalBusiness JSON-LD on the East Brunswick page describes the Livingston office and phone, so structured data contradicts the page
No contact/request-a-quote form anywhere; booking widget is the only non-phone path and its mobile slot buttons truncate ('+11..')
Very thin Google review base (a single review) compared with nearby competitors

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: site is crawlable and sitemapped, but a second legacy site (seesawvisioneb.com) competes for the same name and address, and the Google review count looked like one review. Answerable: hours, address, services and doctor names are plain text - excellent for crawlers - but the LocalBusiness JSON-LD is wrong for this location (Livingston phone/description), so an agent trusting schema gets bad data. Bookable: genuine online scheduler with live slots and no CAPTCHA, though there is no quote/contact form and mobile slot labels are clipped.

operations_signals.signal: Site offers online self-scheduling with per-doctor slot availability alongside phone intake
Patient forms are downloadable PDFs (e.g. medical records release) rather than digital intake
Three-office group still runs a legacy single-office GoDaddy site that takes calls on an old number - inference: enquiries are split across two funnels

top_opportunities.opportunity: Consolidate to one website and one phone number (retire or 301 the old GoDaddy site) and fix per-location LocalBusiness schema so each office's name, address, phone and hours match its page
top_opportunities.evidence: Legacy site live with (732) 247-2847 and a 2025 copyright while the main site uses (848) 308-7504; the East Brunswick page's JSON-LD carries the Livingston phone and ZIP 07039

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an agent-usable intake path: a labelled contact/quote form plus plain-text answers (insurance plans accepted, exam price range, service area, wait times) so a customer's agent can answer and book without calling
top_opportunities.evidence: No forms on any page checked; pricing and insurance detail are only vague pages with no cost ranges

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated post-visit review requests and review responses to build a real Google footprint
top_opportunities.evidence: Third-party directory shows a 5.0 rating from a single review, while a nearby competitor shows 500+

scores.reasons: Gap: decent site with a working scheduler but real, specific breakage (duplicate site, wrong schema, no forms). Pay: a three-location optometry group with optical retail revenue, so a mid-size budget. Ease: the schema and duplicate-site fixes are days of work for one consultant. Evidence: I read the pages and schema directly, but Google listing data came from a directory rather than Google itself, so the review count is less certain.
